thresholds.scoring: case_score = 0 if structural or invariant check fails, else semantic mean in [0,1]; aggregate = mean(case_score) over all non-service-error samples
thresholds.rationale: Invariants (INV-*) are 'must always hold' rules, so any violation fails the run; guardrails likewise. Aggregate 0.85 allows imperfect semantic quality on judgement cases.
